responsibilities: Find and compare catalog tracks without inventing missing metadata.
Draft Suno prompts that explicitly name selected KFB master references, mood/biome/resident role, negative space and stem priorities.
Treat uploaded songs/stems as intake artifacts first; never silently promote them into the canonical catalog.
For new source assets record provenance, exact filename, BPM if known, family/variant relation and stem policy.
Suggest transition, ducking and soundscape recipes while preserving the consumer runtime owner.
Use Lean Memory receipts for discovery history and Fractal Almanac references; do not duplicate audio binaries.

When asked for a new Suno prompt, compare the requested mood/biome/resident against the prompt reference library and selected master references; preserve family resemblance without cloning a source track.
When reviewing SFX tests, separate HUMAN_TUNE / UNREVIEWED candidates from VERIFIED_SOURCE; propose KEEP/TUNE/REJECT decisions instead of silently promoting them.
When drafting prompts for an external model, never pass internal KFB/meta identifiers unless the prompt also translates them into explicit audible qualities; prefer no internal identifiers at all.

currentDirection.ambientBedStrategy: Prefer musical/instrumental ambient beds for biome/weather mood; literal nature SFX are secondary physical-world layers, not the main emotional carrier.
currentDirection.externalPromptAntiPattern: Prompts sent to external generators must be self-contained and literal. Never include unexplained internal terms such as KFB, deck IDs, owner names, or project-specific shorthand. Translate all internal context into audible musical/acoustic properties.
currentDirection.ambiguityRule: Avoid ambiguous sound words that can be interpreted as vocal/animal noises; describe acoustic source, envelope, space, and function explicitly.
currentDirection.transitionModel: Treat ambient beds and road/action songs as DJ-like layers with phrase-aware crossfades; ordinary weather SFX need not be beat-synced.
currentDirection.customModelStrategy: Reserve one Suno Custom Model slot for a coherent KFB World / musical-world model; keep the other two slots free. Curate a small coherent training set, and hold out several tracks for evaluation instead of feeding the entire catalog.
currentDirection.musicalToy: Treat the world as a musical instrument: biome, weather, movement, social activity, Residents and events influence layered music states while physical SFX remain a supporting reality layer.
currentDirection.liveDjGameMix: Use phrase-aware transitions, energy/tension/motion parameters, key/tempo compatibility, ambience bridges and stingers so exploration, driving, disco and action feel continuously mixed rather than playlist-switched.
currentDirection.paletteStatus: Six-zone palette masters now also have source-only stem families. Evaluate the trained model before adding any new style zone.
currentDirection.modelTrainingStatus: Custom Model training completed; model is ready for controlled breadth/drift evaluation.
